additions.group: 数値行列補完・構造化データ・独立学習
additions.reason_selected: Independently trained numerical matrix completion (masked entries across rows and columns, no per-table task labels required); Kumo Tabular predicts designated supervised targets, Kumo Relational consumes relational graphs, Kumo Anomaly is temporal anomaly reconstruction. Keep these non-equivalent assets. Publisher release reports continuation on 250k synthetic matrices / 62,500 updates; save one original state, not two serialization formats.
additions.quality_positive: Fixed release card: MissBench NRMSE 1.256252 (2,091 cases); UCI 1.285373 (3,058 cases), scaled by held-out true column SD. Author reports 77,998,496 trainable parameters, 254 tensors; HF safetensors reports 77,998,688 stored elements. No independent reproduction.
additions.quality_negative: Checkpoint selection used prior MissBench/UCI monitoring; not pristine holdouts. Observed-column-SD NRMSE 4.000035 / 1.045013 differs from held-out-truth scaling. No verified matched Kumo comparison, calibrated uncertainty, or complete-row/column missingness robustness. Synthetic distribution transfer, large-window memory, data rights and runtime unverified. Paper/project-page claims are not automatically attributable to this exact checkpoint.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Lawful consented or licensed scientific/statistical matrix reconstruction only. Imputed values are estimates, not observations; exclude sensitive unapproved data and consequential decisions without validation. No replacement or acquisition authorization.
